comment: The specification assumes access to GTIN, GDSN, WHODrug, IDMP, detailed packaging hierarchies, verified regulator data, and high-availability APIs. These conditions will not hold in every country or for every product class.

public.text: The specification assumes access to GTIN, GDSN, WHODrug, IDMP, detailed packaging hierarchies, verified regulator data, and high-availability APIs. These conditions will not hold in every country or for every product class.
public.suggestedRevision: Define progressive maturity levels beginning with governed product lists and national identifiers, then standard classifications, packaging and global identifiers, regulator integration, eventing, and advanced traceability support.
